Maruti Suzuki CEO Calls for Balance on Auto Regulations and Affordability

Maruti Suzuki India's Managing Director and CEO expressed hope that a balance between regulations and affordability will continue in the future, emphasizing its importance for cleaner and safer mobility. The company's Senior Executive Officer for Marketing & Sales noted a strong demand for passenger vehicles, with entry-level car sales reportedly jumping 100% in the first four months of FY27. Maruti Suzuki sold over 21,000 WagonR units and around 10,000 Alto units last month. The Indian passenger vehicle industry is projected to exceed 53 lakh units in FY27.
